description: Query the NORTH7 knowledge graph of entities and relationships. Entities: countries, companies, assets, commodities, sectors, crises, regions. Shows how entities are connected — e.g. which assets Iran affects, what commodities a crisis impacts, which sectors are linked to a country. Use entity parameter to query a specific entity (e.g. 'IR' for Iran, 'CL=F' for oil, 'energy' for energy sector). Returns matched entities, connected nodes, and weighted edges with evidence. FREE — no API key needed.

entity.description: Entity ID to query: country code (IR, US, CN), ticker (AAPL, CL=F), sector (energy, defense), or name.

type.description: Filter by entity type: country, company, asset, commodity, sector, crisis, region

name: get_relationships
